tools.name: c64_program
tools.title: Runs PRG/CRT files, uploads BASIC or ASM, and coordinates batch test flows.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for program upload, execution, and batch workflows.

path.description: Path to the PRG file: Ultimate path such as //USB0/demo.prg on c64u/u2 (or a host path with location host); host path on VICE.

location.description: auto (default): Ultimate device path on c64u/u2, host path on VICE. host: read the file from the host and upload it (Ultimate). device: Ultimate path only. Limits depend on op.

symbolsFile.description: Label file (VICE .vs, 64tass, ACME or KickAssembler); labels annotate disassembly and are accepted where c64_memory and c64_debug take an address.

program.description: Commodore BASIC v2 program source to upload and run.

verify.description: Poll the screen until the program ends, shows a BASIC error (with its line) or the poll window (C64BRIDGE_POLL_MAX_MS, default 2 s) ends. Without verify nothing is observed. Limits depend on op.

autoFix.description: With verify:true, a BASIC error caused by a missing closing quote or parenthesis is fixed in the failing line and the program rerun (rewritten lines reported). Set false for programs with side effects.

programs.description: Programs to run in order (at most 64).

type.description: Assertion type; sid_silent needs the C64 Ultimate audio stream (c64u backend).

continueOnError.description: Continue running programs after assertion failure

durationMs.description: Duration to run each program before assertions

outputPath.description: Output directory for test results Limits depend on op.

memoryRanges.description: Memory snapshots (at most 256 ranges, 2 MiB in total).

captureDebugReg.description: Capture Ultimate debug registers (C64U/U64 only; default true there, false on U2/VICE).

messageTemplate.description: Greeting template. Use {PLATFORM}/{BACKEND} for uppercase or {platform}/{backend} for lowercase substitution.

captureScreenshot.description: Capture a framebuffer screenshot on C64U/U64 or VICE. U2 skips it; requesting it there fails before execution.

restoreActiveBackend.description: Restore the backend that was active before the workflow started.

inputSchema.description:
Program operations.

Operations:
- load_prg [write]: Load a PRG into memory without running it (Ultimate path, host path on VICE, or location host). Required: path. Optional: location, symbolsFile.
- run_prg [write]: Load and run a PRG: Ultimate path on c64u/u2 (location host uploads a host file), host path on VICE. Required: path. Optional: location, symbolsFile.
- run_crt [c64u, u2] [write]: Run a CRT cartridge image from an Ultimate path, or upload a host file with location host (c64u/u2). Required: path. Optional: location.
- upload_run_basic [write]: Tokenize BASIC v2 source, upload and run it; verify:true reports BASIC errors with their line. Required: program. Optional: verify, autoFix.
- upload_run_asm [write]: Assemble 6502/6510 source (ACME, ca65, 64tass syntax; .include/.incbin read host files), upload and run it. Required: program. Optional: verify.
- batch_run [write]: Run multiple PRG/CRT programs with post-run assertions. Required: programs. Optional: continueOnError, durationMs, outputPath, resetDelayMs.
- bundle_run [write]: Capture screen, memory and debug registers into a bundle. Required: runId, outputPath. Optional: captureScreen, memoryRanges, captureDebugReg.
- cross_platform_greeting [write]: Greet on the configured backends with screenshots and verification. Optional: platforms, messageTemplate, verify, captureScreenshot, outputPath, restoreActiveBackend, timeoutMs, pollIntervalMs.

tools.name: c64_memory
tools.title: Reads or writes RAM, captures the screen, or waits for text matches in one tool.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for memory I/O, screen reads, and screen polling.

address.description: Start address: $HHHH, 0xHHHH, decimal, a loaded program label or documented name (screen, CHROUT), optionally +n or -n.

length.description: Bytes to read (default 256). Limits depend on op.

format.description: hex (default) or dump (16 bytes per line, PETSCII).

bytes.description: Hex bytes to write, like $AABBCC or AA BB CC.

verify.description: Read before and after to verify.

expected.description: Hex data expected before the write.

mask.description: Verification mask (hex); only set bits are compared.

abortOnMismatch.description: Abort the write on pre-write mismatch.

pattern.description: Substring or regex to find (max 200 chars; ^ and $ match at row boundaries) Limits depend on op.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout ms (wait_for_text 1-120000) Limits depend on op.

includeIo.description: Ultimate: allow $D000-$DFFF. Limits depend on op.

instructionCount.description: Stop after this many instructions; replaces length.

source.description: Source start address, in the same forms as address.

dest.description: Destination start address, in the same forms as source.

startAddress.description: Start of the search range, in the same forms as address.

endAddress.description: End of the search range (inclusive), in the same forms as startAddress.

address1.description: First region start address, in the same forms as address.

address2.description: Second region start address, in the same forms as address1.

asPrg.description: Prepend a 2-byte load address (PRG). Default true.

inputSchema.description:
Memory operations.

Operations:
- read: Read a range of bytes with address metadata. Required: address. Optional: length, format, bank.
- write [write]: Write hex bytes into RAM. Required: address, bytes. Optional: verify, expected, mask, abortOnMismatch.
- read_screen: Return the 40x25 text screen as ASCII.
- wait_for_text: Poll the screen for a substring or regex. Required: pattern. Optional: isRegex, caseInsensitive, timeoutMs, intervalMs.
- wait_until: Wait until a condition on memory, the screen or a VICE checkpoint holds. Timeout or maxIterations: success with met false. A failed read ends the wait with a communication_failure error carrying the data so far. Addresses and backend are fixed at the start. Required: condition, timeoutMs. Optional: pollIntervalMs, maxIterations, includeIo.
- list_basic: List the BASIC program in memory as text.
- disassemble: Disassemble memory into 6502/6510 instructions, with loaded labels. Required: address. Optional: length, instructionCount.
- copy_memory [write]: Copy a RAM region to another address. Required: source, dest, length. Optional: includeIo.
- fill_memory [write]: Fill a memory range with a repeating byte pattern. Required: address, length, pattern.
- search_memory: Search a memory range for a byte pattern. Required: startAddress, endAddress, pattern. Optional: maxResults, includeIo.
- compare_memory: Compare two memory regions and report differences. Required: address1, address2, length. Optional: maxDiffs, includeIo.
- save_memory [write]: Dump a memory range to a local file (optional PRG header). Required: startAddress, endAddress, filePath. Optional: asPrg, includeIo.

tools.name: c64_sound
tools.title: Adjusts SID registers, plays files, composes music, and runs verification captures.
tools.description: Play any music file (op play). SID control, composition, SIDWave conversion, audio analysis.

sidwave.description: Inline score (text or object). Limits depend on op.

system.description: Default: the machine's ($02A6). Limits depend on op.

durationSeconds.description: Override capture duration in seconds. Limits depend on op.

voice.description: SID voice (note_on: 1-3). Limits depend on op.

note.description: Note such as C#5; overrides frequencyHz.

frequencyHz.description: Explicit frequency in Hz. Used when note is omitted.

waveform.description: SID waveform to enable. Limits depend on op.

verify.description: Check that the output is quiet. Limits depend on op.

root.description: Tonic and lead register. Limits depend on op.

pattern.description: Repeating lead semitone offsets from root.

preset.description: Classic or varied lead phrasing. Limits depend on op.

style.description: Arrangement style. Limits depend on op.

seed.description: Composition seed (default 65). Limits depend on op.

cpg.description: SIDWAVE score: YAML/JSON text or object. Limits depend on op.

output.description: SID playback needs c64u or u2; SID export with dryRun works anywhere. Limits depend on op.

dryRun.description: Skip playback; return only compilation metadata.

outputPath.description: Host PRG or SID file. Works with dryRun.

analysisDurationSeconds.description: Verification seconds. Limits depend on op.

waitBeforeCaptureMs.description: Verification delay in ms. Limits depend on op.

expectedSidwave.description: Reference SIDWAVE. Limits depend on op.

request.description: "Does it sound right" adds a verdict.

strict.description: Write nothing if content is lost.

forDevice.description: Use the machine's clock and SID model, not its SID count.

inputSchema.description:
Sound operations.

Operations:
- play [write]: Play any music file (SIDWave, SID, MIDI, MOD, tracker and notation formats, PRG): detects, converts, runs, reports losses. Optional: sidwave, inputPath, from, song, voices, system, durationSeconds, configure, outputDir.
- sample_render [write]: Render a SIDWAVE sample to WAV. Optional: definition, rate, outputDir.
- capture_samples [c64u]: Capture Ultimate stereo PCM. Optional: count, encoding.
- set_volume [write]: Set SID volume ($D418). Required: volume. Optional: filterMode.
- reset [write]: Reset SID registers. Optional: hard.
- note_on [write]: Start a SID voice. Optional: voice, note, frequencyHz, system, waveform, pulseWidth, attack, decay, sustain, release.
- note_off [write]: Release a SID voice. Required: voice.
- silence_all [write]: Silence all SID voices. Optional: verify.
- play_sid_file [c64u, u2] [write]: Play an Ultimate SID file. Required: path. Optional: songnr.
- play_mod_file [c64u, u2] [write]: Play an Ultimate MOD file. Required: path.
- generate [write]: Compose and play a seeded SIDWAVE PRG (replaces the program in memory). Optional: includeScore, configure, root, pattern, steps, tempoMs, waveform, preset, system, style, seed.
- compile_play [write]: Compile and optionally play SIDWAVE. Optional: configure, sidwave, cpg, format, output, dryRun, outputPath.
- play_preset [write]: Compile and play a built-in SID preset. Optional: includeScore, configure, preset, platforms, verify, analysisDurationSeconds, waitBeforeCaptureMs, restoreActiveBackend.
- pipeline [write]: Compile, play and analyze SIDWAVE. Optional: configure, sidwave, cpg, output, waitBeforeCaptureMs, analysisDurationSeconds, expectedSidwave, verifySilenceBefore, verifySilenceAfter, silenceDurationSeconds, silenceRmsThreshold, postSilenceWaitMs, silenceWaitMs.
- analyze: Check SID audio or a host WAV (musical structure: analyze_music). Optional: wavPath, request, durationSeconds, expectedSidwave.
- record_analyze: Analyze a recording from the Ultimate stream or host microphone on other backends. Required: durationSeconds. Optional: expectedSidwave.
- render [write]: Render WAV by action: mix (default), stems (not SID), solo or mute (voice). Optional: sidwave, inputPath, action, voice, from, song, durationSeconds, model, outputPath, outputDir, overwrite.
- extract_instruments [write]: Save the instruments of a score or SID as an importable library. Optional: sidwave, inputPath, from, song, durationSeconds, name, licence, author, outputPath, overwrite, includeScore.
- formats: List conversion formats. Optional: from.
- inspect: Detect and describe a music file. Optional: sidwave, inputPath, from.
- convert [write]: Convert between music formats. Optional: sidwave, inputPath, to, from, outputPath, overwrite, strict, verify, song, voices, system, model, durationSeconds, includeScore.
- validate: Check a score. Optional: sidwave, inputPath.
- lint: List a score's musical and hardware problems. Optional: sidwave, inputPath, loop.
- format [write]: Write a score in canonical form. Optional: sidwave, inputPath, outputPath, overwrite, includeScore.
- compile [write]: Compile a score to PRG, SID or game files, without playing. Optional: sidwave, inputPath, output, outputPath, outputDir, overwrite, loop, song, origin, dataOrigin, zeroPage, symbols, assembler, relocation, maxCycles, forDevice.
- transform [write]: Edit a score by action: transpose (semitones), set_tempo (bpm), scale_tempo (factor), restructure (order), quantise (grid), humanise (seed, maxShift), substitute_instrument (from, to). Required: action. Optional: sidwave, inputPath, outputPath, overwrite, includeScore, semitones, bpm, factor, order, grid, seed, maxShift, from, to, scope.
- retarget [write]: Adapt a score to a clock, SID model, SID count or budget. Optional: sidwave, inputPath, outputPath, overwrite, includeScore, system, model, sids, budgetCycles, budgetBytes, allowChanges, forDevice.
- reconstruct [write]: Experimental: approximate score from a SID file or register trace, with a verdict. Required: inputPath. Optional: outputPath, overwrite, includeScore, song, durationSeconds, from, system.
- analyze_music: Musical analysis of a score or SID (key, form, techniques); audio check: analyze. Optional: sidwave, inputPath, song, durationSeconds.
- compare: Compare two scores or SIDs: register differences and verification level. Required: comparePath. Optional: sidwave, inputPath, song, durationSeconds, level, ladder.
- sid_info: SID header, song lengths, STIL notes and player. Required: inputPath. Optional: songlengthsPath, stilPath, hvscDir, hvscPath, sidIdPath.
- sid_edit [write]: Edit a copy by action: header (fields: name, author, released, clock, sidModel, startSong, ...) or songlength (durations "3:05 0:41" into a Songlengths database). Required: inputPath, action. Optional: fields, durations, songlengthsPath, hvscDir, hvscPath, outputPath, overwrite.
- preserve [write]: Preservation bundle by action: create (default; from a SID, into outputDir) or verify (inputPath: the bundle folder). Required: inputPath. Optional: action, outputDir, overwrite, song, durationSeconds, level, ladder, stilPath, hvscPath, hvscDir, includeOriginal, rightsPermitted.
- compose [write]: Compose a new score with form and harmony, without playing. Optional: style, profile, seed, system, root, cycleBudget, outputPath, overwrite, includeScore.
- complete [write]: Extend a score by action: continue (bars), harmonise (voice, target), accompany (bass, drums), fill-section (section). Required: action. Optional: sidwave, inputPath, outputPath, overwrite, includeScore, bars, voice, target, bass, drums, section, after, at, seed, harmony, instrument, verify.

tools.name: c64_system
tools.title: Manages machine state (pause, reset, power) and schedules recurring background tasks.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for power, reset, menu, and background task control.

waitForReady.description: Wait for the BASIC READY. prompt; a timeout gives ready=false, not an error.

name.description: Unique task name (letters, digits, spaces, '_', '-', '.'; must not start with '.' or a space). Limits depend on op.

operation.description: read, write (needs arguments.address and bytes), read_screen, menu_button, or an allowlisted tool.op such as c64_memory.wait_for_text.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of iterations (1 to 100000; omit for indefinite)

inputSchema.description:
System operations.

Operations:
- pause [write]: Pause the machine until resumed.
- resume [write]: Resume CPU execution after a pause.
- reset [write]: Issue a soft reset without cutting power. Optional: waitForReady, readyTimeoutMs.
- reboot [destructive]: Trigger a firmware reboot to recover from faults. Optional: waitForReady, readyTimeoutMs.
- poweroff [c64u, vice] [destructive]: Shut down C64U/U64 or quit VICE. U2-family cannot power off. On C64U/U64 power must be restored at the outlet; it starts by itself only if automatic startup on power restoration is enabled.
- power_cycle [destructive]: Return the backend to a fresh state. C64U/U64 Tool Menu verification needs machine:menu_screen (U64 3.15+ or supporting C64U firmware); U2-family reboots through REST. Optional: waitForReady, readyTimeoutMs.
- menu [c64u, u2] [write]: Toggle the Ultimate menu button.
- read_menu_screen [c64u, u2]: Read the active Ultimate menu's raw character and colour matrix through machine:menu_screen (needs firmware support; U64/U2 3.15+).
- start_task [write]: Start a named interval or one-shot task. Required: name, operation. Optional: arguments, intervalMs, maxIterations.
- stop_task: Stop a background task. Required: name.
- stop_all_tasks: Stop all running tasks and persist state.
- delete_task [write]: Delete a finished task and its artifacts; stop running tasks first. Required: name.
- list_tasks: List background tasks with status.
- task_result: Status and result of a task. Required: name. Optional: waitMs.
- performance_report: Summarize diagnostics spans and tool latencies of the current or latest session. Optional: scope, includeTimeline, maxEntries.

tools.name: c64_select_backend
tools.title: Changes the active backend without restarting the MCP server and reports resulting tool availability.
tools.description: Switch the active backend between C64U/U64 hardware, U2-family cartridges, and the VICE emulator at runtime.

backend.description: Backend to activate for subsequent tool calls.

inputSchema.description:
Runtime backend selection operations.

Operations:
- select: Switch the active runtime backend without restarting the MCP server. Required: backend.

tools.name: c64_graphics
tools.title: Captures frames, renders PETSCII text or art, previews sprites, and displays bitmap images from one tool.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for frame capture and graphics rendering workflows.

includePixels.description: Include raw pixel bytes (about 100 KB per frame; responses above 2 MiB are rejected).

format.description: png returns each frame as an MCP image block (max 4 frames per call). Limits depend on op.

encoding.description: Encoding used for the pixel payload when included.

prompt.description: Natural language prompt for the PETSCII art.

text.description: Exact PETSCII text (overrides prompt). Limits depend on op.

borderColor.description: Border colour index (0-15). Limits depend on op.

backgroundColor.description: Background colour index (0-15). Limits depend on op.

dryRun.description: When true, skip uploading the generated BASIC program to the C64.

bitmap.description: Explicit bitmap definition for PETSCII rendering.

sprite.description: 63-byte sprite definition provided as base64/hex string or array of bytes.

index.description: Sprite index (0-7) to configure in screen memory.

multicolour.description: Enable multicolour mode for the sprite.

dataAddress.description: Where to write the 64-byte block (multiple of 64, inside the current VIC bank); default is chosen clear of screen, charset and bitmap.

imagePath.description: Filesystem path of the source image (PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and other Jimp-supported formats).

bitmapAddress.description: C64 address (integer or hex string like $2000).

screenAddress.description: C64 address (integer or hex string like $2000).

preserveAspect.description: Keep the image aspect ratio, padding with the background colour.

inputSchema.description:
Graphics operations.

Operations:
- capture_frame [c64u, vice]: Capture one or more complete video frames from the active backend. Optional: count, includePixels, format, encoding.
- render_petscii_art [write]: Create PETSCII art from a prompt, text or bitmap, optionally displaying it. Optional: prompt, text, maxWidth, maxHeight, borderColor, backgroundColor, foregroundColor, dryRun, bitmap.
- render_petscii_text [write]: Display PETSCII text with optional border and background colours. Required: text. Optional: borderColor, backgroundColor.
- render_sprite [write]: Display 63-byte sprite data at a position and colour (writes memory and VIC-II registers). Required: sprite. Optional: index, x, y, color, multicolour, dataAddress.
- render_bitmap [write]: Convert an image to VIC-II bitmap, write it to RAM and display it. Required: imagePath, format. Optional: bitmapAddress, screenAddress, borderColor, backgroundColor, preserveAspect.
- get_display_state: Read VIC-II and CIA2 registers to determine the current graphics mode and memory layout.

tools.name: c64_rag
tools.title: Returns knowledge references for BASIC (basic), 6502/6510 assembly (asm) or all curated docs including game development and Ultimate features (docs).
tools.description: Grouped entry point for BASIC, assembly and curated-docs RAG lookups.

inputSchema.description:
RAG operations.

Operations:
- basic: Retrieve BASIC references and snippets from the local knowledge base. Required: q. Optional: k.
- asm: Retrieve 6502/6510 assembly references from the local knowledge base. Required: q. Optional: k.
- docs: Search all curated docs (hardware, Ultimate features, game development, specs) with no BASIC/assembly filter. Required: q. Optional: k.

tools.name: c64_disk
tools.title: Mount or unmount images, create new disks, list drives, and find programs from one tool.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for disk mounts, listings, image creation, and program discovery.

drive.description: Drive identifier (for example drive8). Limits depend on op.

attachmentMode.description: How the firmware attaches the mounted image.

location.description: device (default): Ultimate path. host: upload the image from the host (needs verify false; type from the extension).

driveMode.description: Drive emulation mode to switch to during verification.

verify.description: Power on, reset and verify via the reliability workflow.

powerOnIfNeeded.description: Power on the drive before mounting (verify=true).

tracks.description: Track count (D64 supports 35 to 41; DNP requires explicit tracks).

root.description: Root path to search Limits depend on op.

waitMs.description: Delay after firmware run before returning

captureCandidates.description: Include up to this many candidates in result

inputSchema.description:
Disk operations.

Operations:
- list_drives: List drive slots and mounted images.
- mount [write]: Mount a disk image, optionally verifying. Required: drive, image. Optional: type, attachmentMode, location, driveMode, verify, powerOnIfNeeded, resetAfterMount, maxRetries, retryDelayMs.
- unmount [c64u, u2] [write]: Unmount the image from a drive slot. Required: drive.
- file_info [c64u, u2]: Inspect a file on the Ultimate filesystem. Required: path.
- create_image [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Create a blank disk image. Fails if the file already exists. Required: format, path. Optional: diskname, tracks.
- find_and_run [c64u, u2] [write]: Find a PRG/CRT by name substring and run the first match. Required: nameContains. Optional: root, extensions, caseInsensitive, sort, waitMs, captureCandidates.
- find_paths [c64u, u2]: Find Ultimate storage paths containing a name substring; runs nothing. Required: nameContains. Optional: root, extensions, maxResults, caseInsensitive.

tools.name: c64_drive
tools.title: Power cycle drive slots, reset IEC state, switch emulation modes, or load custom ROMs.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for drive power, mode, reset, and ROM operations.

drive.description: Drive identifier: a, b, softiec (or "IEC Drive"), or a bus number such as 8 or drive8.

inputSchema.description:
Drive operations.

Operations:
- reset [write]: Issue an IEC reset for the selected drive slot. Required: drive.
- power_on [write]: Power on a specific Ultimate drive slot. Required: drive.
- power_off [write]: Power off a specific Ultimate drive slot. Required: drive.
- load_rom [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Temporarily load a custom ROM into an Ultimate drive slot. Required: drive, path.
- set_mode [write]: Set the emulation mode for a drive slot (1541/1571/1581). Required: drive, mode.

tools.name: c64_printer
tools.title: Print text or bitmaps and define custom characters for Commodore or Epson printers.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for Commodore and Epson printing helpers.

text.description: Text to print on the connected printer.

target.description: Printer target: Commodore MPS (PETSCII) or Epson FX (ESC/P).

secondaryAddress.description: Secondary address for device 4 (0 = upper/graphics, 7 = lowercase). Limits depend on op.

formFeed.description: Emit a form-feed (CHR$(12)) at the end of the job.

repeats.description: Number of times to repeat the row (1-255).

useSubRepeat.description: Repeat the next byte this many times (Commodore BIM SUB).

ensureMsb.description: Ensure MSB set for Commodore printers.

density.description: Density parameter when using Epson mode '*'.

timesPerLine.description: Number of times to print the row per line (1-10).

firstChar.description: PETSCII code of first character to redefine (33-126).

items.description: Commodore MPS DLL character definition (11 columns).

inputSchema.description:
Printer operations.

Operations:
- print_text [write]: Generate BASIC that prints text to device 4. Required: text. Optional: target, secondaryAddress, formFeed.
- print_bitmap [write]: Print a bitmap row (Commodore BIM or Epson ESC/P). Required: printer, columns. Optional: repeats, useSubRepeat, secondaryAddress, ensureMsb, mode, density, timesPerLine.
- define_chars [write]: Define custom printer characters (Commodore DLL mode). Required: firstChar, chars. Optional: secondaryAddress.

tools.name: c64_config
tools.title: List or update settings, access firmware info, take snapshots, and run program shuffle workflows.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for configuration reads/writes, diagnostics, and snapshots.

category.description: Configuration category (e.g. 'Audio'). Limits depend on op.

item.description: Configuration item (e.g. 'Volume'). Limits depend on op.

includeSecretValues.description: Return credential values (network password, FTP/Telnet passwords, Wi-Fi keys) in plain text. Default false: those values are replaced with ***.

value.description: Configuration value (string, number or boolean). Limits depend on op.

updates.description: Categories mapped to item/value pairs (primitive values only), for example {"Audio": {"Volume": 80}}.

additionalProperties.description: Item/value pairs of one category (primitive values only).

applyToFlash.description: When true, save the restored configuration to flash immediately (C64U/U64 and U2 only).

root.description: Directory to search for programs (not recursive; the firmware lookup returns one match per extension)

durationMs.description: Duration to run each program in milliseconds

maxPrograms.description: Maximum number of programs to run

outputPath.description: Output directory for run logs and captures

inputSchema.description:
Configuration operations.

Operations:
- list: List configuration categories reported by the firmware.
- get: Read a configuration category or specific item. Required: category. Optional: item, includeSecretValues.
- set [write]: Write a configuration value in the selected category. Required: category, item, value.
- batch_update [write]: Apply several configuration updates at once. Pass `updates` as {category: {item: value}}. Optional: updates.
- load_flash [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Load configuration from flash. Optional: category.
- save_flash [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Persist the configuration to flash. Optional: category.
- reset_defaults [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Reset configuration to factory defaults. Optional: category.
- read_debugreg [c64u]: Read the Ultimate debug register ($D7FF).
- write_debugreg [c64u] [destructive]: Write a hex value to the Ultimate debug register ($D7FF). Required: value.
- info: Retrieve Ultimate hardware information and status.
- version: Fetch firmware version details.
- snapshot [write]: Snapshot configuration to disk. Required: path.
- restore [write]: Restore configuration from a snapshot file. Writes only items that differ; a category the device refuses (e.g. 403 for a wrong network password) does not stop the others and is named in the error. Required: path. Optional: applyToFlash.
- diff: Compare configuration with a snapshot. Required: path.
- shuffle [c64u, u2] [write]: Run each PRG/CRT found, optionally capturing the screen. Optional: root, extensions, durationMs, captureScreen, maxPrograms, outputPath, resetDelayMs.

tools.name: c64_extract
tools.title: Export sprites or charsets, dump RAM, compute filesystem stats, or run firmware health checks.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for sprite/charset extraction, memory dumps, filesystem stats, and firmware health checks.

address.description: Start address ($HHHH or decimal) Limits depend on op.

length.description: Number of bytes to scan Limits depend on op.

minSetBits.description: Minimum number of set bits required

includeBase64.description: Include each sprite as base64 too

pauseDuringRead.description: Pause the machine during memory read

scanRange.description: Range to scan if address not provided: 'common' or 'full'

outputPath.description: File path to write charset binary Limits depend on op.

includeContainers.description: Include container images in extension stats

maxSamplesPerExtension.description: Number of sample paths to keep per extension

inputSchema.description:
Extraction operations.

Operations:
- sprites [write]: Scan RAM for sprites, optionally exporting .spr files. Required: address, length. Optional: stride, maxSprites, minNonZeroRows, minSetBits, includeBase64, includeRows, outputDir, pauseDuringRead.
- charset [write]: Locate and extract 2KB character sets from RAM. Optional: address, scanRange, outputPath, pauseDuringRead, minNonEmptyChars, minEntropy.
- memory_dump [write]: Dump a RAM range to hex or binary files with a manifest. Required: address, length, outputPath. Optional: format, chunkSize, pauseDuringRead, retries.
- fs_stats [c64u, u2]: Per-extension size statistics for one directory (no recursion; at most one file per extension). Optional: root, extensions, includeContainers, maxSamplesPerExtension.
- firmware_health: Run firmware readiness checks and report status metrics.

tools.name: c64_stream
tools.title: Start or stop audio/video/debug streaming in a single tool.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for starting and stopping Ultimate streaming sessions.

target.description: UDP stream destination: IPv4 address or hostname, optional :port (1-65535), e.g. 192.168.1.10:11000. Sent unencrypted.

inputSchema.description:
Streaming operations.

Operations:
- start [write]: Start an Ultimate streaming session. The device sends an unencrypted UDP stream to the target (IPv4 address or hostname, optional :port). Required: stream, target.
- stop [write]: Stop an active Ultimate streaming session. Required: stream.

tools.name: c64_debug
tools.title: Manage breakpoints, inspect registers, and step through code on the VICE backend.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for VICE debugger operations (breakpoints, registers, stepping).

address.description: Start address: $HHHH, 0xHHHH, decimal, a loaded program label or documented name (screen, CHROUT), optionally +n or -n.

endAddress.description: End address (inclusive) of an address range, in the same forms as address.

enabled.description: Whether the checkpoint is enabled. Limits depend on op.

items.description: Selects a register by id or name.

value.description: Value: integer, or string such as "$C000" or a label[+n].

expectedPC.description: PC address to wait for, in the same forms as address.

inputSchema.description:
Available debugger operations.

Operations:
- list_checkpoints: List all active VICE checkpoints (breakpoints).
- get_checkpoint: Fetch a single checkpoint by id. Required: id.
- create_checkpoint [write]: Create a new checkpoint (breakpoint) in VICE. Required: address. Optional: endAddress, stopOnHit, enabled, temporary, label, operations, memspace.
- delete_checkpoint [write]: Remove a checkpoint by id. Required: id.
- toggle_checkpoint [write]: Enable or disable a checkpoint by id. Required: id, enabled.
- set_condition [write]: Attach a conditional expression to a checkpoint. Required: id, expression.
- list_registers: List available registers (metadata). Optional: memspace.
- get_registers: Read register values, optionally filtered by name or id. Optional: memspace, registers.
- set_registers [write]: Write register values. Required: writes. Optional: memspace.
- step [write]: Single-step CPU execution. Optional: count, mode.
- step_return [write]: Continue execution until the current routine returns.
- get_monitor_state: Read CPU registers and return the current monitor state. Optional: memspace.
- wait_for_state: Wait until the CPU is stopped (checkpoint or step) and, with expectedPC, PC equals it, or the timeout elapses. Without a debug session the registers are polled. Optional: expectedPC, timeoutMs, pollMs.
- nuclear_reset [destructive]: Kill and restart the VICE process (managed instances only).
- continue_execution [write]: Exit the Binary Monitor and resume CPU execution (BM 0xAA Exit).

tools.name: c64_vice
tools.title: Reads or updates selected VICE resources that are safe to expose through MCP.

inputSchema.description:
VICE emulator operations.

Operations:
- resource_get: Read a VICE configuration resource (safe prefixes only). Required: name.
- resource_set [write]: Write a VICE configuration resource (safe prefixes only). Required: name, value.
- snapshot_save [write]: Save snapshot. Required: path.
- snapshot_restore [destructive]: Restore snapshot. Required: path.
- version: VICE version.

tools.name: c64_input
tools.title: Types text, sends physical key combinations, and controls joysticks.
tools.description: Cross-platform PETSCII typing plus native Ultimate keyboard and joystick events.

text.description: Text to type: printable ASCII (letters sent as PETSCII upper case), \n for RETURN, and {TOKEN}s such as {RETURN}, {CLR}, {F1}…{F8}, {UP}, colour names, {$1D}/{29}. Unmappable characters and unknown tokens are rejected.

key.description: Key to press: a printable character or PETSCII token name (RETURN, F1…F8, UP). STOP only types code 3 and may not break a running program; use op keyboard with run_stop on C64U.

durationMs.description: Delay in ms between presses (default 0). Limits depend on op.

count.description: Number of times to press the key (default 1).

controls.description: List of controls to activate simultaneously.

action.description: press = hold until a release call; release = restore all bits; tap = press then release after durationMs.

inputs.description: One or more keys to transition together (for example left_shift + a).

transition.description: press holds, release frees, tap presses and releases.

inputSchema.description:
Input operations: write_text, key, keyboard, joystick, release_all, state.

Operations:
- write_text [write]: Send a text string to the keyboard buffer, with PETSCII token expansion. Required: text. Optional: delayMs.
- key [write]: Press one key one or more times, optionally with a delay. Required: key. Optional: durationMs, count.
- joystick [c64u, vice] [write]: Simulate joystick input. On C64U/U64 this uses machine:input. On VICE it attaches the joyport simulation device, which pulls CIA lines 5-7 low: port 1 produces phantom keys and port 2 reads $1E for up instead of $7E. Prefer port 2 on VICE and test bits 0-4. Required: port, controls, action. Optional: durationMs.
- keyboard [c64u] [write]: Send physical C64 keyboard matrix events through machine:input (needs firmware support; U64 3.15+). Required: inputs, transition.
- release_all [c64u] [write]: Release every key and joystick control injected through machine:input.
- state [c64u]: Read the keys and joystick controls held through machine:input.

tools.name: c64_batch
tools.title: Runs an ordered list of tool commands and returns all results with per-command timing.
tools.description: Execute multiple c64bridge tool calls in a single request. Reduces latency for multi-step workflows.

commands.description: Ordered list of commands to execute.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the tool (must include 'op' for grouped tools).

description.description: Optional label for this command in the result.

stopOnError.description: Halt the batch after the first failure. Default: true.

inputSchema.description: Execute multiple tool calls in one request.
